evidence_note: Historical aggregate measurements; private execution evidence omitted. This is not the original integrity manifest.

rule.latency_scope: Local Python function only; Apple M1 Max

definitions.accuracy: Correct action / all rows, including gold defer; errors count incorrect.
definitions.defer: Abstention, not task completion. Fallback-needed rate includes errors too.
definitions.non_defer_accuracy: Correct among successful non-defer decisions only.
definitions.observed: Actual inspection and post-action snapshots; masked rows excluded.
definitions.macro_f1: Mean over four action classes; absent class contributes zero.
definitions.calibration: Valid four-action probabilities only. Ten equal-width ECE bins. Multiclass Brier sums squared class errors.
definitions.latency: Arm-specific prediction timing. Small-sample p95 is descriptive. Initialization excluded when source excluded it.
definitions.sampling: One prediction per example; related snapshots are correlated. Paired intervals resample prototype families, not rows.

limitations: Replay-only metrics do not establish Harbor task success or actual LLM-call savings.
One-seed exploratory experiment; sparse family counts and calibration samples.
Historical training families form a new diagnostic; not an out-of-distribution test.
